title: Ambient Weather Observation Weekly Wind Speed Trend
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ambientweather:obs wind_kmh=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(wind_kmh) as avg_duration, max(wind_kmh) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst wind speed for Ambient Weather observation events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture wind_kmh on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average wind speed with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It scans whether Ambient Weather observation tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
